name: PageHeader
intent: The top of a page's content: where it sits (breadcrumb), what it is (title, badge, and an optional icon) and the page actions. Below the AppHeader.
usage: Put one PageHeader at the top of each page, under the AppHeader. It is one component: breadcrumbs are the parent sections (all links), then the title row with an optional badge, and an icon before the title only when you pass one (none by default), and the page actions on the end. actions are kit Buttons, size sm, with the one primary last; moreActions puts less-used actions in a More menu before them. sticky is the compact bar for when the page scrolls: one line whose trail ends in the page title, with a raised shadow unless shadow is false. See contracts/pageheader.json for the full contract. The bar adds no side padding of its own: the page inset comes from the layout class around it (contracts/layout.json), so the title lines up with the Sections under it. The bar is the top of the page, so it sits flush against the frame's bar with no page inset above it; the pattern holding it (AppShell, RecordPage) takes care of that.

title.note: The page name. It is the page's h1.

breadcrumbs.itemShape: { label: string; href?: string; onClick?: () => void }
breadcrumbs.note: Parent sections, all links. Sticky adds the title as the last, current crumb.

icon.note: Optional. Leave it out by default: the title stands on its own. Pass a Material Symbols name, like folder_open, only when the page wants an icon before the title; the kit Icon draws it at size lg in the brand color.

badge.note: A status after the title, like Draft. A kit Badge.

actions.note: Kit Buttons, size sm: secondary first, one primary last. At most five visible actions including More.

moreActions.itemShape: { id: string; label: string; icon?: string; danger?: boolean } | { divider: true }
moreActions.note: Adds a More menu (kit DropdownMenu, tertiary and unbordered) before the actions, for less-used ones. Delete goes last, as danger. Give each one its icon, so the menu reads at a glance.

sticky.note: Compact 52px bar that sticks to the top of the scroll area: the trail ends in the title, no title row. The bar runs the full width of the page, bleeding back out through the page inset and paying it back as padding, so its line reaches both edges and nothing scrolls past it in the gutters while the title stays lined up with the Sections.

shadow.note: With sticky, a subtle line and a shadow that falls downward only, so the full-width bar does not read as a floating card.

useWhen: The top of every page: record pages, lists, settings.
A page that scrolls: switch to sticky once the title scrolls away.
doNot: Do not invent ContentHeader, PageTitle, TitleBar or a local heading row.
Do not put the app's logo, search or user in it. That is the AppHeader.
Do not put more than one primary Button in actions, or more than five visible actions.
Do not give it side padding to inset the page. Wrap the page in .layout-content, which owns that inset.
a11y: A header with the page's h1. In sticky the h1 stays, hidden, and the trail marks the title as the current page.
The breadcrumb is the kit Breadcrumb (a nav named Breadcrumb). More is a kit DropdownMenu.
The icon is decorative; the title names the page.
snippet:
<PageHeader
  breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Billing", href: "/billing" }, { label: "Invoices", href: "/invoices" }]}
  title="INV-1042"
  badge="Draft"
  moreActions={moreActions}
  actions={<>
    <Button size="sm">Send</Button>
    <Button size="sm" variant="primary">Approve</Button>
  </>}
/>
